dict.string: Trio requires screen recording permission to observe user workflows during demonstrations, synthesize video previews, and automate desktop tasks.
Trio requires microphone access for voice dictation and conversational companion audio input.
Trio requires Speech Recognition permission to transcribe spoken commands and conversational dialogue.
Trio requires AppleEvents permission to control and automate native macOS applications hands-free.
Trio requires Accessibility access to interact with native desktop application UI elements without displacing the cursor.
